column1: # derivation: §9.1, §9.7: ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 2 FOLLOWING within the
# partition, by id; the current row is not in it. MIN and MAX skip NULL
# inputs (§2.1); a frame of only NULLs, or an empty frame, answers NULL
# NULL, NULL; id 7 {}: NULL, NULL. g = 3: id 8 {}: NULL, NULL.
# A frame stays within the current row's partition: standard SQL window
# semantics, which no item states yet.
# Types: id, g, v, w, u keep their scanned types; windowed MIN and MAX have
# v's type, INT64, nullable because v is nullable (§8.26).
